description: Search for routes by name or number. Returns matching routes with IDs. Use to resolve a route short name (e.g. "44") to a route ID for schedule or vehicle lookups with onebusaway_get_vehicles or onebusaway_get_schedule_for_route.

maxCount.description: Maximum number of results to return. A positive integer, at most 100. Defaults to 10.

name: onebusaway_search_routes

cap.description: The maxCount limit applied to truncated results.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `endpoint_unavailable`: The search/route endpoint returns 404 on this OBA instance (e.g. Puget Sound). `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

limitExceeded.description: True if more routes match than were returned; raise maxCount or refine the query to see all.

notice.description: Guidance when no routes matched — e.g. try onebusaway_find_routes with coordinates, or onebusaway_list_routes_for_agency.

query.description: Route name/number query sent to the API.

items.description: A transit route with agency and type information.

agencyId.description: Agency ID that operates this route.

agencyName.description: Agency name that operates this route.

id.description: Agency-prefixed route ID (e.g. "1_100259"). Use with onebusaway_get_vehicles or onebusaway_get_schedule_for_route.

shortName.description: The number or short name displayed on vehicles (e.g. "44").

shown.description: Number of routes returned when results were truncated.

truncated.description: True when matching routes exceeded maxCount.

title: Search Routes by Name or Number
